verdict.rationale: Docs show skills/ folder is declared 'harness-agnostic' and 'shared verbatim' across many agent runtimes (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Devin, Hermes, Grok Build, OpenCode, Antigravity), with a cross-runtime alias directory (~/.agents/skills/) and a porting guide that adds only a bootstrap/tool-mapping layer without touching SKILL.md content — strong support for vendor-agnostic skill folders. However, none of the evidence explicitly names or cites the open Agent Skills specification itself, and installation/bootstrapping still differs per harness (superpowers-gh-5), so full spec-compliance isn't independently confirmed. Missing for 10: explicit reference to the named Agent Skills open standard, and independent/third-party confirmation that the skill folder validates unmodified outside Superpowers' own harness list.
